name: MS8V2 8-channel passive mic splitter
notes: 1RU passive splitter: each of 8 balanced mic inputs (front XLR-F) feeds a direct Out and a transformer-isolated Link Out (rear XLR-M pair per channel), with a ground lift switch and a 0 / -40 dB attenuator per channel, and inputs linkable in pairs (1-2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-8). Phantom power passes through from the direct side. No mains power. Connector sides taken from product photos. Check: the depth.
